scope: Functional live SMP/TLB diagnosis and passive CPU/remote-ACK/clock snapshots in Spectra.

implementation.ownership: Spectra controls explicit CHECK SMP and passive METRICS SMP with common text/NDJSON/export; privileged mapping, CPU binding and native worker facts stay at their exact kernel owners.
implementation.shared_cases: Existing finite checksum workload, actual CPU placement, old/new mapping observations on every selected CPU, monotonic clock samples and own heap/mutex contention are shared with boot. Cases, workers, mapping and live caller protocol are separate source units.
implementation.resources: A resident per-probe ledger retains exact range/frames, task incarnations and failed per-CPU heap return identities. Actual task/metadata retirement precedes every mapping/frame release; partial acquisition and unacknowledged release stay visible without blind retries. The exact caller and workers retain task unwind admission over waits.
implementation.worker_binding: Shared generic diagnostic Ledger supports the existing scheduler checks and bound SMP workers. Native typed CPU binding preserves the original private mutator range/state rules. Startup waits leave the ready list instead of spinning on the BSP.
implementation.acknowledgments: Paging unmap shares its existing rollback/retention body with an optional exact primary tlb::Result receipt. Own request generation/target/ACK/offline masks are not inferred from global counter deltas or local invlpg counters.
implementation.live_boundaries: Live work excludes global DROP_ACK, serial/global owner baselines, nested heap acceptance and R4L boot extras. Failed legacy SMP work retains its gate. There is no speedup threshold or separate performance index.
implementation.passive: Current online/schedulable masks, functional clock registration/quality and remote request/ACK/timeout counters are loaded passively. No all-owner atomicity or historical boot success is claimed; functional clock quality remains available without detail metrics.
implementation.api: Append-only R4DEV v17 after preserved416-byte prefix, total432, slots50/51. Fixed ProgramKernelSmpCheck v1=224bytes and ProgramSmpTlbSnapshot v1=184bytes; old types/constants/slots unchanged. Contract0.64.14 and SDK0.64.26 exact public pins required before acceptance.
implementation.frontend: CHECK SMP /ADMISSION and existing THREAD /KERNEL:ADMISSION share one bounded two-caller/real-join helper. Invalid headers/capacity preserve output; larger caller tails stay unchanged. Single-CPU use is unavailable without a multicore workload.

scoped_smp4.own_task_receipts: 5/5 per complete SMP request; no retained tasks, frames, ranges or heap allocations
scoped_smp4.concurrent_admission: one owner, one busy, real join; distinct next run identity

scoped_single_cpu.availability: default and ADMISSION report unavailable; no workload, run id, task, frame or mapping

comparison_previous_release.observation: Single mandatory run per release; context and method comparison is descriptive, not a causal speedup claim. No extra run for improved scores.

performance_policy.reason: SMP task/mapping lifetime refactor and shared paging/task helper changes can affect runtime; exactly one final STANDARD SMP4 with verified original DevCenter import after final artifacts.

limits: QEMU evidence only; no physical hardware claim.
Global DROP_ACK remains isolated; production timeout/rollback/frame-retention behavior stays authoritative.
Full real exports, samples and functional output remain outside Git; only short technical summaries and immutable reference descriptors are versioned.
